blocks.text: 50750 Yale Road East Chilliwack Rosedale V0X 1X2

parts.t: Welcome to this charming 1,730 sq.ft. 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in the heart of Rosedale, sitting on nearly a quarter-acre lot. There’s plenty to love here, including a detached garage/workshop, a spacious rec room, and a 10x14 loft that gives you extra space for kids, work, hobbies, or storage. Outside, there’s room for the RV, boat, and all the toys, with beautiful open field and mountain views in the background. Set in a quiet, established neighbourhood, you’re just a short walk to Rosedale Traditional Community School, making mornings a little easier for the kids. A great mix of space, views, and that small-town Rosedale feel.
